solution_steps: '''Tribute summon''' the Creator by Tributing the Creator Incarnate and Marshmallon to the graveyard.
Activate the Creator's effect. Bring '''Creator Incarnate''' back from the graveyard by discarding '''Bazoo the Soul Eater'''.
Activate Premature Burial. Bring '''Bazoo the Soul Eater''' to the field in face up attack position.
Activate Bazoo the Soul Eater's special effect. Remove from play '''Marshmallon''' and '''Divine Dragon Ragnarok'''.
Enter battle phase, and attack '''first''' with '''Bazoo the Soul Eater'''.
Attack '''directly''' with '''The Creator-Incarnate''' and '''The Creator''' untill opponent's lifepoints reach 0.
